text:
elena: CI red on my PR #4827 — integration/db-connection failed in the matrix. It looks flaky (passed earlier). Any way to rerun just that job without triggering the full image rebuild? I want to preserve the docker cache.

raj: you can rerun the workflow run with gh, which won't touch image build if the job is the same run. grab the run id from the Actions page or from ci-bot below.

elena: ah, nice — what's the exact command?

raj: e.g. `gh run rerun 1234567890` then pick the job, or from CLI: `gh run rerun 1234567890 --jobs "integration/db-connection"` (we usually pipe that through our wrapper).

oliver: if it's Buildkite job use `buildkite-agent pipeline upload`? nah, ignore, we mostly use GH here. For preserving cache, the important part is to avoid a new image job. If the job is a test-only job that depends on an earlier image-build job, rerunning the test job in the same run will reuse the image artifacts.

ci-bot: Build failed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/actions/runs/1234567890 (run id 1234567890)

elena: perfect, run id is there. Trying `gh run rerun 1234567890` now.

raj: another quick option: we have an internal helper that targets a job and skips image rebuilds: `scripts/ci/rerun_job.sh --run 1234567890 --job integration/db-connection --skip-image`. That calls the GH API and filters jobs.

jen: FYI there's a short runbook in the infra docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/ci/reruns — covers GH CLI and the wrapper script, plus when it's safe to skip rebuilding images.

elena: ran the wrapper, seems to have started the single job, logs showing `Using cached image: redwood-ci/cache:latest` :thumbsup:

oliver: if it flakes again, we can bisect by re-running the job across a few recent commits: `scripts/ci/bisect_flaky.sh --job integration/db-connection --start SHA1 --end SHA2`. It automates resubmits across a range.

elena: good to know. If rerun fails and it's consistently failing, should I escalate to eng-oncall or file a flaky-test ticket?

raj: first check the logs for DB connection strings / timeouts, sometimes it's infra (staging DB creds flapping) vs test code. If it's infra-y, ping eng-oncall and drop the `@eng-oncall` mention in the thread. If it's clearly test logic, open a quick issue and assign a reviewer.

jen: quick checklist we use: 1) rerun single job w/ wrapper (skip-image) 2) check cached image in logs 3) if repeat failure, run bisect script 4) escalate with run link and last failing logs attached.

elena: thanks all — rerun succeeded, tests passed this time. Will follow up if it reappears. :relieved:
